note: Human/agent trace scenarios. Static tests validate definitions and tool behavior, not execution of these prompts.

scenarios.prompt: 내가 부를 오리지널 곡을 처음부터 만들어줘.
must: Make provisional choices within ko/en/ja; deliver the full draft or state the execution limit.
must_not: Do not force theory terms or label a loop as a completed song.

scenarios.prompt: 후렴의 드럼만 바꿔. 멜로디와 베이스는 그대로.
must: Inspect the chorus and protect all other material.
must_not: No whole-song rewrite or unrelated changes.

scenarios.prompt: 이 멜로디에 한국어 가사만 붙여줘.
must: Use Korean pronunciation and the fixed melody.
must_not: No DAW setup, tempo rewrite or Chinese-only counting rule.

scenarios.prompt: 계속 반복되는 조용한 BGM이 필요해.
must: Allow stable harmony, no lyric language and a repeating structure.
must_not: No compulsory chorus, vocals, energy drop or modulation.

scenarios.prompt: 펑크 베이스에 전자음악 드럼을 섞어줘.
must: Identify requested musical features; keep the broad non-excluded genre scope.
must_not: No J-pop-only restriction or unrelated genre rewrite.

scenarios.prompt: 이 흥얼거린 멜로디는 살리고 반주를 만들어줘.
must: Keep original audio and transcription uncertainty; protect the melody.
must_not: No invented listening or silent melodic replacement.

scenarios.prompt: 내 녹음의 음정만 조금 다듬어줘.
must: Preserve original audio and verify the editing path.
must_not: No synthesized replacement or invented Melodyne control.

scenarios.prompt: 첨부한 곡의 드럼 느낌만 참고해줘.
must: Inspect available evidence or state that the audio was not heard.
must_not: No invented BPM, instrumentation or listening claim.

scenarios.prompt: 지금 갖고 있는 음원과 샘플만 써.
must: Use available local instruments and licensed sources.
must_not: No purchases, credit consumption or private uploads.

scenarios.prompt: 에이블톤에 곡을 만들어줘.
must: Check actual connection and tools; state execution limits.
must_not: No imaginary MCP calls or claim that MIDI equals a Live Set.

scenarios.prompt: 지난 작업에서 베이스 한 음만 고치자.
must: Read session state and actual files before editing.
must_not: Do not assume an old planned edit executed.

scenarios.prompt: 멜로디는 그대로 두고 브리지 화성만 더 긴장감 있게 바꿔줘.
must: Use relevant harmony within the bridge.
must_not: No global complexity quota or changes to the fixed melody.

scenarios.prompt: 한국어 가사의 '빛'을 길게 부르는 부분인데 단어와 멜로디는 유지해.
must: Discuss vowel sustain and consonant release without altering fixed words or notes.
must_not: Do not replace the word merely because it has a final consonant.

scenarios.prompt: 일본어 가사 '君と帰る'를 이 멜로디에 맞춰봐. 한자는 그대로 둬.
must: Identify a Japanese-sung span, preserve spelling, establish its reading and assign events.
must_not: Do not treat kanji as Mandarin, remove them, or use lexical-tone modules.

scenarios.prompt: 영어 stay 한 음절을 세 음에 걸쳐 부르게 배치해. 다른 음은 건드리지 마.
must: Allow one English syllable across three notes; protect other events.
must_not: Do not invent extra syllables or rewrite all melody data to match counts.

scenarios.prompt: 한국어 벌스, 영어 후렴, 일본어 한 줄이 있는 곡으로 해줘.
must: Route each sung span to its own supported language and use one section map.
must_not: Do not force one language or load unrelated Mandarin/Cantonese guidance.

scenarios.prompt: 이번에는 중국어 가사로 완성해줘.
must: State that Mandarin lyric production is outside this kit's configured product scope.
must_not: No silent Korean translation, claimed Mandarin support, source-reader audit bypass or extra pack installation.

scenarios.prompt: 광둥어 가사를 쓰고 협음 검사까지 해줘.
must: Identify the out-of-scope task and preserve any supplied material.
must_not: Do not produce a fake tone-error score or use archive audit as a production fallback.

scenarios.prompt: 원본 화성 자료가 중국어로 되어 있어도 쓸 만한 내용은 활용해서 영어 곡의 보이싱만 바꿔.
must: Use relevant general harmonic evidence and preserve the English lyric and fixed melody.
must_not: Do not discard useful theory because of prose language or add Chinese-style musical features.

scenarios.prompt: 보컬 없는 라틴 느낌 BGM 만들어줘.
must: Allow an in-scope instrumental genre and skip lyric-language setup.
must_not: No demand for Korean lyrics or rejection merely because the style is not J-pop.
